text: PJSC GK TNS Energo is a Moscow Exchange-listed electricity-sales holding. Kommersant reported in June 2025 that AO FinAlyans ST became its largest shareholder in 2024 after buying 28.6% of its shares; the sales are disputed in court by Sunflake Limited, linked to arrested former owner Dmitry Arzhanov.
short: TNS Energo's largest shareholder is AO FinAlyans ST (28.6%, per Kommersant); stake disputed in court.

source.name: Kommersant (Nizhny Novgorod): Акции высокого напряжения
source.note: Translation: the buyer of the shares was AO FinAlyans ST; in the course of last year, having bought the shares, this company became the largest shareholder of PJSC GK TNS Energo.
source.quote: В течение прошлого года, купив акции, это общество стало крупнейшим акционером ПАО ГК «ТНС энерго».
